description: This file contains functions related to the boot process, including hook management, pivoting root filesystems, and setting up overlays for initramfs environments in an OpenWrt-based system.

methods.name: boot_hook_splice_start
methods.description: Initializes the splice hook mechanism by exporting a variable.

methods.name: boot_hook_splice_finish
methods.description: Finalizes the splice hooks by processing the stack list and exporting environment variables.

methods.name: boot_hook_init
methods.description: Initializes a specific hook by adding it to the stack list.

methods.name: boot_hook_add
methods.description: Adds a function to a specified hook, with optional splicing.

methods.name: boot_hook_shift
methods.description: Removes and retrieves the first function from a hook's list.

methods.name: boot_run_hook
methods.description: Executes all functions registered in a specified hook.

methods.name: pivot
methods.description: Performs a pivot root operation and moves system directories to new locations.

methods.name: fopivot
methods.description: Sets up an overlay filesystem and pivots to it.

methods.name: ramoverlay
methods.description: Creates a RAM-based overlay filesystem environment.
